text:
olivia: Observed onboarding sample app exceeding client window after token refresh during pagination. Repro locally.

nate: Can you paste logs?

olivia: Short log:
```
INFO req=pg-7 inflight=6 status=401
INFO token refresh start id=tok-99
INFO token refresh done id=tok-99
INFO retry req=pg-7 inflight=7 duplicate send
WARN upstream 429 backlog=45
```
Looks like the inflight counter increments when the retry occurs but the original permit wasn't released.

kevin: JS SDK parity note: py-sdk releases permits on any terminal state before retries. If JS only releases on success we get leaks.

olivia: Repro steps: set client.windowSize=6, launch 80 parallel paginated calls, expire token mid-flight. Results: inflight climbs to 8-9 and we see duplicate requests and soft 429s.

nate: Short-term mitigation: have auth wrapper call window.release() before refresh and re-acquire after; risky but quick. Long-term: implement lease-based acquires so retries reuse the same lease id.

kevin: Lease sketch:
```js
const lease = await window.acquireLease();
try {
  await sendWithAuth(req, {leaseId: lease.id});
} finally {
  await window.releaseLease(lease.id);
}
// sendWithAuth keeps using leaseId for retries so count remains stable
```
That prevents double-acquire.

devex-bot: Created ticket RDW-3478: "sampleapp: client window overshoot on auth retry" and linked branch r/patch/window-lease.

doc-bot: Suggested docs update: add a short section in quickstart about windowing and auth retries with code sample.

nate: I'll add a failing integration test in sampleapp that simulates mid-batch token expiry. Kevin, can you own the SDK change once test is in?

kevin: Yup, I'll take the SDK PR. Also will add a small note in the quickstart explaining lease vs counter approaches. :thumbsup:
